Security is embedded at every layer of the network, scaling to support any AI application while
simplifying even the most sophisticated campus and enterprise environment.

[Learn about Smart Switches][34]

[See the future of the edge][35]

professional services.

# Groupe SNCF

[Groupe SNCF][Groupe SNCF]][6]
* Découvrir le Groupe
* Agir pour la mobilité
* Défendre un monde durable
* Inventer l'avenir
* [#EnCoulisses][7]

## La SNCF sur les routes du Tour de France !

Fournisseur officiel de la plus grande course cycliste au monde, la SNCF vibre au rythme des
exploits des coureurs et de la ferveur des millions de spectateurs massés le long du parcours de la
Grande Boucle.

[En savoir plus][8]

## Découvrez notre actualité

### Fortes chaleurs : quelles conséquences ?

Découvrez leurs impacts sur les infrastructures ferroviaires et nos mesures pour assurer votre
sécurité.

[En savoir plus][9]

### On se retrouve aux Journées européennes du patrimoine !

Nous organisons 160 événements, du 18 au 20 septembre partout France, pour célébrer le patrimoine
ferroviaire.

[En savoir plus][10]

### Les coulisses du métier de chef de bord

À rebours des clichés qui circulent sur les « contrôleurs », partez à la rencontre de trois d'entre
eux.

[En savoir plus][11]

### L’étude qui bouleverse les idées reçues sur les transports

À l’occasion de ses 20 ans, Keoscopie, l’observatoire des modes de vie et des mobilités de Keolis,
dresse un panorama des habitudes de déplacement des Français.

[En savoir plus][12]

## Notre Groupe en quelques chiffres
* [TGV INOUI sur le quai d'une gare]
  
  On transporte
  
  15 M
  
  de passagers chaque jour dans le monde
* On a réalisé
  
  43 Mds€
  
  de chiffre d’affaires en 2025
  
  [Consultez nos actualités financières][13]
* [Train et panneaux solaires]
  
  On vise
  
  -30%
  
  d’émissions de gaz à effet de serre sur nos activités de transport en 2030 (vs 2015)
  
  [En savoir plus sur notre stratégie RSE][14]

### Notre présence dans le monde

Le saviez-vous ? Nous opérons des bus au Danemark et du métro en Inde, nous convoyons des
marchandises en avion depuis la Chine vers le Mexique et construisons des tours en Chine...
Découvrez nos 1001 projets, dans 120 pays dans le monde.

[En savoir plus][15]

## En cyclisme, que signifie « bâcher » ?
* ### Couvrir son vélo
  
  Choisir la réponse Couvrir son vélo
  
  #### Eh non, pas cette fois-ci.
  
  Rejouez
* ### Se protéger de la pluie
  
  Choisir la réponse Se protéger de la pluie
  
  #### Eh non, pas cette fois-ci.
  
  Rejouez
* ### Abandonner la course
  
  Choisir la réponse Abandonner la course
  
  #### Bravo !
  
  [En savoir plus][16]

Grande Boucle.

[En savoir plus][8]

sécurité.

[En savoir plus][9]

ferroviaire.

[En savoir plus][10]

### Les coulisses du métier de chef de bord

À rebours des clichés qui circulent sur les « contrôleurs », partez à la rencontre de trois d'entre
eux.

[En savoir plus][11]

# What if AI could do an engineer’s most tedious work?

We’ve launched the Eigen Engineering Agent, purpose-built AI for industrial automation engineering.
It moves AI beyond generating suggestions to executing engineering tasks end-to-end. Now available
for more than 600,000 TIA Portal users.

[Start free trial][3][How AI transforms Engineering][4]
[CES 2026: Roland Busch & Jensen Huang, Siemens & NVIDIA]

## Building the operating system for Industrial AI

Together with NVIDIA, we are building the Industrial AI operating system for the physical world.
Read the latest news from our ever-expanding partnership here.

[Learn more][5]
[Vectron X Primary - Tec Keyvisual 16to9]

## Vectron X – the next dimension of rail technology

The next generation of locomotives for freight and passenger transport combines the proven platform
technology with app-based functionalities, open interfaces for third-party providers, in an open
ecosystem – connecting people, places and portfolios more closely than ever before.

[Read more][6]
[bx-overview-panoramic-city-skyline-is485896260-xcelerator-shape-hero-2560x1440]

At the University of Wollongong, a digital twin brings together data from 1,000 assets, 500 BMS
points, energy meters and documents, to create a single source of truth and enable efficient,
data-driven operations acrossthe campus.

[Explore Building X][7]
[Amazonia rainforest]

Deep in the Amazon, a cooperative partnered with Natura to extract essential oils from native
plants. We brought a digital twin to their extraction process, cutting energy and water use while
boosting income for the local community by 60%.

# What if AI could do an engineer’s most tedious work?

We’ve launched the Eigen Engineering Agent, purpose-built AI for industrial automation engineering.
It moves AI beyond generating suggestions to executing engineering tasks end-to-end. Now available
for more than 600,000 TIA Portal users.

[Start free trial][3][How AI transforms Engineering][4]
[CES 2026: Roland Busch & Jensen Huang, Siemens & NVIDIA]

## Building the operating system for Industrial AI

Together with NVIDIA, we are building the Industrial AI operating system for the physical world.
Read the latest news from our ever-expanding partnership here.

[Learn more][5]
[Vectron X Primary - Tec Keyvisual 16to9]

## Vectron X – the next dimension of rail technology

The next generation of locomotives for freight and passenger transport combines the proven platform
technology with app-based functionalities, open interfaces for third-party providers, in an open
ecosystem – connecting people, places and portfolios more closely than ever before.

[Read more][6]
[bx-overview-panoramic-city-skyline-is485896260-xcelerator-shape-hero-2560x1440]

## One digital twin, clear operational insight

At the University of Wollongong, a digital twin brings together data from 1,000 assets, 500 BMS
points, energy meters and documents, to create a single source of truth and enable efficient,
data-driven operations acrossthe campus.

[Explore Building X][7]
[Amazonia rainforest]

## A digital twin in the Amazon rainforest

Deep in the Amazon, a cooperative partnered with Natura to extract essential oils from native
plants. We brought a digital twin to their extraction process, cutting energy and water use while
boosting income for the local community by 60%.

[Read the story][8]
[A person wearing a headset interacts with a holographic display of 3D models and data
visualizations.]

register now.

intelligence, simulation and smart technologies, moving you from digital blueprint to real-world
impact.

## Protect: our sustainability programme for a safer, greener, more inclusive world

As a global leader in defence, aerospace, cyber and digital technology, Thales plays a pivotal role
in developing solutions that help address the major societal and environmental challenges of our
times.

Fostering a more responsible and sustainable society through technology.

[ More about our impact on Society ][145]

### Planet

Changing how we operate in line with the planet’s limits.

[ More about our impact on the Planet ][146]

Working together to build an inclusive and attractive workplace where everyone can develop into
their best selves.

[ More about our impact on our People ][147]

### United States

We have supported our customers and partners for over 130 years with innovative solutions to keep
you safe, moving, protected and connected.

A trusted partner of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia with a presence of over 50 years, Thales provides
advanced solutions in Defence, Public Security, Civil Aviation, Space, Enterprise and Cybersecurity.

### India

Present in India since 1953, Thales supports growth with more than 2,200 staff and advanced
solutions.

# Toshiba America | Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions

## About Toshiba AMERICA

### Toshiba specializes in providing comprehensive Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions
### across the Americas.

[ Learn More ][246]

## From Power Generation to Decarbonization: Toshiba Leads the Way

Anchoring the power generation capabilities of our Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions,
Toshiba America Energy Systems (TAES) focuses on advanced power generation and decarbonization. We
provide technical services for installed energy equipment while pioneering carbon-neutral
technologies—including hydrogen, carbon capture, and next-generation geothermal. From thermal and
nuclear to hydro power, TAES is building a reliable path forward.

 

Discover how we’re shaping the energy landscape for a cleaner planet.

[ Learn More ][247]
[Rolling green hills with wind turbines in the background, symbolizing Toshiba's commitment to
sustainable power generation and clean energy solutions.]
[Wind-powered energy-generated windmills on a green hillside.]
[Technician in hard hat and safety vest working on industrial equipment, representing Toshiba's
on-site services for manufacturing and critical infrastructure.]

## Driving Sustainability: Toshiba's Industrial and Infrastructure Innovations

Spearheading the manufacturing and infrastructure side of our Energy, Industrial, and Electronics
Solutions, Toshiba International Corporation (TIC) delivers technologies for a resilient future. We
maximize efficiency with high-performance motors, hybrid vehicle systems, and power electronics like
UPS and solar inverters. From sustainable transportation to water treatment, TIC provides the
innovation and reliability that powers modern industry.

 

Discover how we’re revolutionizing industrial solutions and infrastructure for a better future.

[ Learn More ][248]

## Empowering the Future: Semiconductor & Data Innovations

Defining the technological edge of our Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions, Toshiba
America Electronic Components (TAEC) leads in semiconductors and data storage. Our energy-efficient
power devices—including Si, SiC, and GaN—and high-capacity hard disk drives support a rapidly
developing AI world. From automotive to industrial applications, we deliver the technology driving
modern innovation.

 

Discover how we’re leading the semiconductor revolution for a smarter, more sustainable future.

[ Learn More ][249]
[Close-up of a Toshiba semiconductor chip overlaid on the internal components of a hard drive,
illustrating Toshiba’s advanced semiconductors and data storage solutions.]

# Toshiba America | Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions

## About Toshiba AMERICA

### Toshiba specializes in providing comprehensive Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions
### across the Americas.

[ Learn More ][246]

## From Power Generation to Decarbonization: Toshiba Leads the Way

Anchoring the power generation capabilities of our Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions,
Toshiba America Energy Systems (TAES) focuses on advanced power generation and decarbonization. We
provide technical services for installed energy equipment while pioneering carbon-neutral
technologies—including hydrogen, carbon capture, and next-generation geothermal. From thermal and
nuclear to hydro power, TAES is building a reliable path forward.

 

Discover how we’re shaping the energy landscape for a cleaner planet.

[ Learn More ][247]
[Rolling green hills with wind turbines in the background, symbolizing Toshiba's commitment to
sustainable power generation and clean energy solutions.]
[Wind-powered energy-generated windmills on a green hillside.]
[Technician in hard hat and safety vest working on industrial equipment, representing Toshiba's
on-site services for manufacturing and critical infrastructure.]

## Driving Sustainability: Toshiba's Industrial and Infrastructure Innovations

Spearheading the manufacturing and infrastructure side of our Energy, Industrial, and Electronics
Solutions, Toshiba International Corporation (TIC) delivers technologies for a resilient future. We
maximize efficiency with high-performance motors, hybrid vehicle systems, and power electronics like
UPS and solar inverters. From sustainable transportation to water treatment, TIC provides the
innovation and reliability that powers modern industry.

 

Discover how we’re revolutionizing industrial solutions and infrastructure for a better future.

[ Learn More ][248]

## Empowering the Future: Semiconductor & Data Innovations

Defining the technological edge of our Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions, Toshiba
America Electronic Components (TAEC) leads in semiconductors and data storage. Our energy-efficient
power devices—including Si, SiC, and GaN—and high-capacity hard disk drives support a rapidly
developing AI world. From automotive to industrial applications, we deliver the technology driving
modern innovation.

 

Discover how we’re leading the semiconductor revolution for a smarter, more sustainable future.

[ Learn More ][249]

illustrating Toshiba’s advanced semiconductors and data storage solutions.]

Wabtec is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added

## Inspiring the Next Generation of Innovators

For 14 years, Wabtec Girls Camp has inspired young girls to explore STEM through hands-on
challenges, mentorship from Wabtec engineers, and experiences that build confidence, spark
curiosity, and expand future opportunities.

[ Learn more ][135]
[Rewiring Europe’s Freight Rail for a Digital Future]

## Rewiring Europe’s Freight Rail for a Digital Future

As Europe's freight rail industry advances toward a more connected future, digital technologies are
creating new opportunities to improve safety, efficiency, and reliability. Daniel Gradl, President
of Brakes & Couplers at Wabtec explores how telematics, Digital Automatic Couplers (DAC),
intelligent yard operations, and industry collaboration are helping drive this transformation.

[ Read the Story ][136]
[Breathing Easier on Paris' RER A]

## Improved Air Quality for the Paris RER A line

On the RER A, the busiest line in the Paris region, RATP is taking steps to improve air quality with
Green Friction. Developed by Wabtec, this innovative braking solution helps significantly reduce
particulate emissions, making a real difference in underground and closed environments where it
matters most.

## Up to 30% Fuel & Emissions Savings

### FLXdrive™ Battery Electric Locomotive

Over the last year, Wabtec took a bold step toward a low-to-zero-emission locomotive future with the
world’s first heavy-haul 100-percent battery-electric locomotive – called FLXdrive™. The locomotive,
powered by approximately 20,000 battery cells, was tested in revenue operation across more than
13,320 miles of hilly terrain in San Joaquin Valley, California.

Operating in a consist between two other locomotives and with a battery capacity of 2.4 megawatt
hours, FLXdrive successfully reduced overall fuel consumption by more than 11 percent — the
equivalent to over 6,200 gallons of diesel fuel saved and approximately 69 tons of CO2 emissions
reduced.

The next version of FLXdrive is currently in development and expected to be ready for market in
2023. With a battery capacity of more than 7 megawatt hours, we anticipate further reducing fuel
consumption and emissions by up to 30 percent.

[ Learn more about FLXdrive™ Battery Electric Locomotive Read more [Continue reading] ][152]
[Wabtec: Innovating with Purpose]

## Improving Air Quality

### Next Generation Friction Technology

Wabtec’s Green Friction technology is the result of the Company’s expertise in friction materials
and significant investments in the methodology of measuring the particles emitted during braking.

Over the past year, this technology has undergone rigorous testing with Paris region operator, RATP,
and has proven its ability to reduce particle emissions from friction braking on metro trains by up
to 90 percent. RATP and Wabtec have equipped two trains that operate on one of the busiest lines in
Europe with this new technology for a final pilot. This technology represents a significant
milestone on the journey towards cleaner tunnels for passengers and network personnel.

[ Learn more about Next Generation Friction Technology Read more [Continue reading] ][153]
[Wabtec Port Optimizer]

## Increasing throughput & improving efficiency

### Port Optimizer™

Wabtec is increasing port throughput and improving efficiency with Port Optimizer™, a cloud-based
software initiative integrating data from across the port ecosystem. It helps the supply chain
monitor and respond to dynamic conditions, align people and resources, and proactively communicate
across functions – enabling maximum port throughput and delivery performance.

Not only does Port Optimizer™ improve efficiencies - it provides an opportunity for ports to
differentiate themselves from their competitors. The timely sharing of accurate information about
container moves, status changes, asset management, etc. across all port stakeholders is needed to
better plan for operations. As a neutral party, Port Authorities can be the driving force to create
a Digital Infrastructure for the collection, aggregation and standardization of data flowing through
the port and to make that data readily available through APIs and various applications.

  ## Ship with BNSF
  
  From the materials that help create products people use every day to the actual finished products,
  our consistent and cost-effective service takes products of any size to customers when and where
  they need them.
  
  No matter what you're shipping, BNSF has a service to meet your needs.
  
  [ LEARN MORE ][53]

    ## New to Rail or BNSF?
    
    Learn how easy it is to become a BNSF customer. We will show you how to get a rate, ship, track
    and manage your account by using our online tools.
    
    [ LEARN MORE ][56]
  * [BNSF Advantage][57]
    
    ## BNSF Advantage
    
    Our enduring commitment is to be the best transportation partner for our customers. Because when
    you win, we win together. We call this the BNSF Advantage.
    
    [ LEARN MORE ][58]
  * [Rail Development][59]
    
    ## Rail Development
    
    Are you developing a new facility or looking to expand? You can rely on BNSF’s team of experts
    to help educate you on the benefits of incorporating our rail network into your supply chain.
    BNSF’s Economic Development team can help guide you through the process of expanding, developing
    or selecting a site.
    
    [ LEARN MORE ][60]
  * [Preserve Rail Competition][61]
    
    ## Preserve Rail Competition
    
    At BNSF, we believe in collaboration, not consolidation. The UP-NS merger has the potential to
    reshape the competitive landscape that supports your business. The Surface Transportation Board
    (STB), which oversees rail mergers, is committed to a transparent and inclusive review, and they
    want to hear directly from those who will be most impacted.
    
    [ LEARN MORE ][62]
  * [Sustainability for Customers][63]
    
    ## Sustainability for Customers
    
    Rail is the most environmentally efficient mode of surface transportation and at BNSF we are
    committed to improving the efficiency of our network in a way that benefits both our customers
    and the environment.

tailor-made approach — rooted in the Italian manufacturing tradition — with the world’s leading OEMs

## Why Book IRCTC Train Ticket on ConfirmTkt

### Get Confirmed Train Tickets

### UPI Enabled Secured Payment

### Free Cancellation on Train Tickets

### Train Booking & Enquiry Support

24X7 customer support, for any train enquiry & booking related queries call 08068243910.

### Instant Refund & Cancellation

Get an instant refund and book your next Train ticket easily.

### Live Train Status Tracking

Train status & notification of your train tickets.

[ ][2]
[app download impression]

### IRCTC Ticket booking on ConfirmTkt

ConfirmTkt is one of the highest rated App to book IRCTC train tickets online. You can book a train
ticket on ConfirmTkt App or website with your existing IRCTC login credentials or create a new one.
Increase your chance of getting a Confirm train ticket with our best-in-market same-train alternates
and prediction feature. IRCTC train enquiry and booking are backed by a unique and efficient
algorithm that predicts your IRCTC PNR in seconds based on historical trends. Alternatively, you can
[**book IRCTC train tickets**][3] on ixigo.

## Confirmtkt: Official Train Ticketing Partner of The Royal Challengers Bengaluru

Come join us on the RCB Express and become a #TrainTicketKing. Win match tickets and more exciting
prizes on our [ mobile app! ][4]

### IRCTC

IRCTC stands for Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation. It is a subsidiary of Indian
Railways and is responsible for online ticket booking, catering, and tourism services. IRCTC was
established in 1999 and is headquartered in New Delhi, India.

IRCTC's online ticketing platform, called the IRCTC Next Generation e-Ticketing System, allows users
to book train tickets, check train availability, and track the status of their bookings. The
platform has also introduced various features such as e-wallets, cancellation and refund facilities,
and the option to book meals and accommodation on trains.

Apart from ticketing services, IRCTC also offers catering services to passengers through its
e-catering services. Passengers can pre-book meals and have them delivered to their seats during
their train journey. IRCTC also manages a chain of restaurants under the brand name "Food Plaza" and
"Jan Aahar" across various railway stations in India.

IRCTC also provides tourism services through its website, offering various tour packages and hotel
bookings for destinations across India. The corporation has also introduced various luxury trains,
such as the Maharaja Express and the Buddhist Circuit Tourist Train, which offer a unique travel
experience to passengers

ConfirmTkt is an authorised partner of IRCTC and IRCTC has its App as IRCTC Rail Connect

### IRCTC Booking Types:

#### IRCTC UTS (Unreserved ticketing system)

IRCTC UTS is a very handy mobile application, through which you can reserve paperless tickets. With
the app on your smartphone, you need not visit the ticket booking counter. One can also get a hard
copy of the ticket booked through the UTS app through ATVMs (automatic ticket vending machines). The
app also runs in an offline mode, through which you can book a ticket, even if you do not have an
internet connection. People buying tickets through the app can pay through the R-wallet (Railway
wallet).

##### IRCTC Full Tariff Rate (FTR)

At times, people need to book an entire coach or train for occasions like tours and parties. The FTR
(Full Tariff Rate) feature of IRCTC enables one to make such bookings. To avail discounts on FTR

## Владельцы берегов озера Щучье

][18]
Озеро Щучье считается одной из самых престижных территорий курортной зоны Бурабай. Здесь расположены
отели, санатории, базы отдыха и ведомственные объекты. Редакция Shishkin_like изучила публичную
кадастровую карту, корпоративную отчетность и реестры, чтобы выяснить, кому принадлежат наиболее
крупные земельные участки на берегу озера Щучье. И это далеко не всегда гламурные отели. Два участка
принадлежат частной школе IQanat High School Айдына Рахимбаева, по соседству с ним р
[

## Как Family Park оказался под контролем частной компании

][19]
В мае этого года стало известно, что государственные органы намерены добиваться возврата территории
Family Park в госсобственность. Проверка выявила изношенную инфраструктуру, вопросы к безопасности
аттракционов, неудовлетворительное содержание территории и отсутствие развития парка на протяжении
многих лет. Спустя месяц в соцсетях начали распространятьсяслухи, что после возврата государству
Family Park на его месте якобы могут построить жилой комплекс, но акимат Алматы офици
[Как Family Park оказался под контролем частной компании][Как Family Park оказался под контролем
частной компании]
[

][20]

развития агроэкономики. В целом, меры государства направлены на повышение конкурентоспособности
отечественного АПК и увеличение доли переработки, в том числе глубокой. Отметим, что усилия не
напрасны, положительная динамика есть (за прошлый год объём валовой продукции, например, увеличился

## SMART Railway Technology GmbH

Sie sind auf der Suche nach einem kompetenten Ansprechpartner für Leistungselektronik von
Schienenfahrzeugen? Als Anbieter von Standardprodukten sowie von kundenspezifischen Seriengeräten
finden wir für Sie eine auf Ihre Bedürfnisse zugeschnittene Lösung.

Denn SMART Railway steht seit Jahrzehnten für alles aus einer Hand. Vom Angebot bis zum Ende der
Lebensdauer finden Sie bei uns Know-How in jeder Phase Ihres Projekts.



Neuzugang im Portfolio

Seit Januar 2024 neu im Portfolio: mit PV2Rail stellt SMART Railway einen spezialisierten
Photovoltaik-Wechselrichter vor, der darauf ausgelegt ist, direkt in das 16,7 Hz Bahnstromnetz
einzuspeisen. Diese Innovation ermöglicht die direkte Nutzung von erneuerbaren Energien in der
unmittelbaren Nähe von Bahntrassen, ohne den kostspieligen Umweg über das herkömmliche dreiphasige
50 Hz-Netz gehen zu müssen. PV2Rail ist somit eine verbrauchernahe und energieeffiziente Lösung.



[ mehr » ][27]





Produktübersicht

Die  SMART Railway ist Hersteller von innovativen Bordnetzumrichtern für den internationalen
Schienenverkehr. Das Produktspektrum reicht von Einzelgeräten wie Batterieladegeräten oder
Klimaumrichtern bis hin zu kompletten Bordnetzumrichtern für Reisezugwagen und Triebzüge. Die
vielfältig einsetzbare Systemtechnik zeichnet sich durch zukunftsweisende Leistungselektronik, hohe
Zuverlässigkeit und Robustheit aus.

[Dinghan Germany - Ihr Partner für Leistungselektronik von Schienenfahrzeugen]



[ mehr » ][28]





Unternehmen

SMART Railway – dieser Name steht für jahrzehntelange Erfahrung auf dem Gebiet hocheffizienter

## SMART Railway Technology GmbH

Sie sind auf der Suche nach einem kompetenten Ansprechpartner für Leistungselektronik von
Schienenfahrzeugen? Als Anbieter von Standardprodukten sowie von kundenspezifischen Seriengeräten
finden wir für Sie eine auf Ihre Bedürfnisse zugeschnittene Lösung.

Denn SMART Railway steht seit Jahrzehnten für alles aus einer Hand. Vom Angebot bis zum Ende der
Lebensdauer finden Sie bei uns Know-How in jeder Phase Ihres Projekts.



Neuzugang im Portfolio

Seit Januar 2024 neu im Portfolio: mit PV2Rail stellt SMART Railway einen spezialisierten
Photovoltaik-Wechselrichter vor, der darauf ausgelegt ist, direkt in das 16,7 Hz Bahnstromnetz
einzuspeisen. Diese Innovation ermöglicht die direkte Nutzung von erneuerbaren Energien in der
unmittelbaren Nähe von Bahntrassen, ohne den kostspieligen Umweg über das herkömmliche dreiphasige
50 Hz-Netz gehen zu müssen. PV2Rail ist somit eine verbrauchernahe und energieeffiziente Lösung.



[ mehr » ][27]





Produktübersicht

Die  SMART Railway ist Hersteller von innovativen Bordnetzumrichtern für den internationalen
Schienenverkehr. Das Produktspektrum reicht von Einzelgeräten wie Batterieladegeräten oder
Klimaumrichtern bis hin zu kompletten Bordnetzumrichtern für Reisezugwagen und Triebzüge. Die
vielfältig einsetzbare Systemtechnik zeichnet sich durch zukunftsweisende Leistungselektronik, hohe
Zuverlässigkeit und Robustheit aus.

[Dinghan Germany - Ihr Partner für Leistungselektronik von Schienenfahrzeugen]

### [ 12 juli - Pendelritjes met PCC tram voor 100j Van Beverenplein ][14]

Zoals te lezen in onze meest recente Actua, is het in het weekend van 11 en 12 juli 100 jaar geleden
dat de tramlijn werd verlengd vanaf de De Smetbrug tot het Van Beverenplein.

Om dat jubileum en ons tramerfgoed een beetje extra in de kijker te zetten, worden er op zondag 12
juli pendelritjes gereden tussen de haltes Van Beverenplein en Wittekaproenenplein. Dit met de
historische PCC 25 van de voormalige MIVG.

Deze ritten zullen plaatsvinden tussen 12u en 15u, met een frequentie van circa 30 minuten.
Op- en afstappen kan aan het Van Beverenplein en het Wittekaproenenplein, maar ook aan de
tussenliggende haltes. Geef een duidelijk signaal aan de bestuurder dat je mee wilt rijden en de
deuren worden geopend.

In samenwerking met VVM De Lijn en met steun van Stad Gent worden deze ritten gratis aangeboden.

 

[Foto PCC 25 - Collectie Michel Reps]
PCC 25 aan het Griendenplein - Foto Collectie Michel Reps. 


 
* [Read more about 12 juli - Pendelritjes met PCC tram voor 100j Van Beverenplein][15]

### [ 100 jaar tram naar het Van Beverenplein ][16]

Op 11 juli 2026 is het precies 100 jaar geleden dat de tram verlengd werd van de De Smetbrug naar
het Van Beverenplein.

Het Van Beverenplein in Gent. Voor veel Gentenaars (en anderen) klinkt het bekend. Niet omdat er
zoveel bijzonders gebeurt, maar omdat het decennialang een eindbestemming was voor de tram.

De geschiedenis van deze eindhalte is ter gelegenheid van dit jubileum dan ook uitgeschreven in een
nieuwe "Actua", namelijk Actua 64 met als toepasselijke titel "100 jaar tram naar het Van
Beverenplein: wat een geschiedenis!"

De actua is te raadplegen door op de preview hieronder te klikken, of via de ["Publicaties"
pagina.][17]

[[Actua 64]][18]


 
* [Read more about 100 jaar tram naar het Van Beverenplein][19]

### [ Prettige Feestdagen! ][20]

Het is de periode van Wensen, Hoop, en Vooruitzichten richting 2026. 🎄En naast de traditionele
kerstboodschap, hebben we ook goed nieuws, een van onze wensen voor 2026 is nu reeds vervuld
geraakt. Weliswaar niet door de Kerstman, maar door positief denken en inzetten op samenwerking met
onze koepel organisatie META Vzw en VVM De Lijn.🥳

Op de valreep nog in 2025, (maar nèt iets te laat voor de Kersttram) zijn PCC 25 en PCC 6208 (ons
dienstvoertuig) de afgelopen maand (na de nodige aanpassingen en technische correcties) succesvol
door een serie keuringen, remtesten, en inspecties geraakt, en hebben we vorige week een
keuringsattest voor 6 maanden mogen in ontvangst nemen.🍾🥂

❓Waarom 6 maanden en maar twee trams?: Omdat achter de schermen we nog steeds samen met Meta Vzw en
De Lijn hard aan het samenwerken zijn om het hele kader rond ritten met tram-erfgoed te hertekenen,
op alle vlakken èn voor allè verenigingen op de drie Vlaamse tramnetten! Onze ervaringen met de
keuring van deze twee "youngtimers" helpen mee dit proces & kader verder uit te werken voor andere &
oudere rijtuigen. 👍🥂

(En samen met de voertuigen van onze collega-verenigingen en onze 3 andere trams, gaan de 6208 en 25
ook terug mee dat proces in!)

Conclusie? Positiviteit, samenwerken en vooruitdenken opent deuren, creëert mogelijkheden en
opportuniteiten, en mooie vooruitzichten voor iedereen! 🥂

Dus, Vrolijke Kerst 🎄, en op naar een succesvol 2026! 🥂

overheid een podcast serie opgenomen met verhalen uit/over het rijke tramverleden van Vlaanderen.

Deze zijn te beluisteren via de website van 150 jaar tram: [Podcast "Langs het venster van den

### [ Kersttram 2024 ][30]

Uitzonderlijk rijden er dit jaar geen nostalgische kersttrams in Gent, Antwerpen of aan de kust.

De reden hiervoor is dat De Lijn en de erfgoedverenigingen sinds de tramjubilea in Gent (2024) en
Antwerpen (2023) werken aan een vernieuwd, robuust kader voor rijdende erfgoedtrams op het netwerk.
De veiligheid van zowel reizigers, vrijwillige medewerkers en andere weggebruikers staat daarin
centraal.
* [Read more about Kersttram 2024][31]

### [ 150 jaar tram Gent: sporen door de tijd ][32]

Naar aanleiding van de viering van 150 jaar tram in Gent, is er door uitgeverij Snoeck (In opdracht
van Meta Vzw & in nauwe samenwerking met ETG Vzw) ook een boek uitgebracht, met als titel: "150 jaar
tram Gent: sporen door de tijd"

Dit rijkelijk geillustreerd boek neemt je mee op een historische reis door 150 jaar tramgeschiedenis
in Gent.
Aan de hand van nooit eerder gepubliceerde foto's, anekdotes en de meest markante mijlpalen ontdek
je het onweerstaanbare verhaal over anderhalve eeuw trams in onze Arteveldestad.

Verkrijgbaar in de betere boekhandel, en via [de webshop van Meta Vzw][33].

[[cover boek 150j tram]][34]
* [Read more about 150 jaar tram Gent: sporen door de tijd][35]

### [ NMVB Netplannen 1934 & 1944 ][36]

Door toedoen van een gulle schenker kregen we enige tijd geleden een archief in ons bezit bestaande
uit zowel NMVB documenten en materiaal, als De Lijn documenten en materiaal.

In samenwerking met onze collega's van Nostalbus was een deel daarvan reeds te zien op hun
opendeurdag in Lochristi begin Juni.
Ondermeer de NMVB netplannen uit 1934 en 1944 werden voor die gelegenheid gedigitaliseerd en
gereproduceerd.

Gezien dat deze plannen samen de evolutie tonen van het NMVB netwerk tussen 1934 en 1944, zijn ze
ook toegevoegd aan de [historische documenten][37] sectie van onze website.

Te bekijken door [hier te klikken voor 1934][38], [hier voor 1944][39], of op de afbeeldingen
hieronder.

[[nmvb netplan 1934]][40]

[[nmvb netplan 1944]][41]
* [Read more about NMVB Netplannen 1934 & 1944][42]

### [ Bekendmaking Datums Viering 150j Tram ][43]

Reeds meerdere jaren in voorbereiding samen met de collega's van Meta Vzw, en meer nieuws volgt heel
spoedig, maar nu kunnen we alvast de datums aankondigen van de viering van 150j tram in Gent: 18&19
mei 2024.

[[-]][44]
* [Read more about Bekendmaking Datums Viering 150j Tram][45]

### [ Kersttram 2023 ][46]

Ook in 2023 zetten we natuurlijk de traditie met onze sfeervolle Ex-MIVG kersttram verder in Gent!

[_]

Op zaterdag 16 en zondag 17 december , en vrijdag 22&29 en zaterdag 23&30 december kan je in Gent
meesporen met onze sfeervol verlichte Kersttram, dit steeds tussen 17u en 22u.

dienstvoertuig) de afgelopen maand (na de nodige aanpassingen en technische correcties) succesvol
door een serie keuringen, remtesten, en inspecties geraakt, en hebben we vorige week een
keuringsattest voor 6 maanden mogen in ontvangst nemen.🍾🥂

❓Waarom 6 maanden en maar twee trams?: Omdat achter de schermen we nog steeds samen met Meta Vzw en
De Lijn hard aan het samenwerken zijn om het hele kader rond ritten met tram-erfgoed te hertekenen,
op alle vlakken èn voor allè verenigingen op de drie Vlaamse tramnetten! Onze ervaringen met de
keuring van deze twee "youngtimers" helpen mee dit proces & kader verder uit te werken voor andere &
oudere rijtuigen. 👍🥂

(En samen met de voertuigen van onze collega-verenigingen en onze 3 andere trams, gaan de 6208 en 25
ook terug mee dat proces in!)

Conclusie? Positiviteit, samenwerken en vooruitdenken opent deuren, creëert mogelijkheden en
opportuniteiten, en mooie vooruitzichten voor iedereen! 🥂

Dus, Vrolijke Kerst 🎄, en op naar een succesvol 2026! 🥂

### [ 12 juli - Pendelritjes met PCC tram voor 100j Van Beverenplein ][14]

Zoals te lezen in onze meest recente Actua, is het in het weekend van 11 en 12 juli 100 jaar geleden
dat de tramlijn werd verlengd vanaf de De Smetbrug tot het Van Beverenplein.

Om dat jubileum en ons tramerfgoed een beetje extra in de kijker te zetten, worden er op zondag 12
juli pendelritjes gereden tussen de haltes Van Beverenplein en Wittekaproenenplein. Dit met de
historische PCC 25 van de voormalige MIVG.

Deze ritten zullen plaatsvinden tussen 12u en 15u, met een frequentie van circa 30 minuten.
Op- en afstappen kan aan het Van Beverenplein en het Wittekaproenenplein, maar ook aan de
tussenliggende haltes. Geef een duidelijk signaal aan de bestuurder dat je mee wilt rijden en de
deuren worden geopend.

In samenwerking met VVM De Lijn en met steun van Stad Gent worden deze ritten gratis aangeboden.

 

[Foto PCC 25 - Collectie Michel Reps]
PCC 25 aan het Griendenplein - Foto Collectie Michel Reps. 


 
* [Read more about 12 juli - Pendelritjes met PCC tram voor 100j Van Beverenplein][15]

### [ 100 jaar tram naar het Van Beverenplein ][16]

Op 11 juli 2026 is het precies 100 jaar geleden dat de tram verlengd werd van de De Smetbrug naar
het Van Beverenplein.

Het Van Beverenplein in Gent. Voor veel Gentenaars (en anderen) klinkt het bekend. Niet omdat er
zoveel bijzonders gebeurt, maar omdat het decennialang een eindbestemming was voor de tram.

De geschiedenis van deze eindhalte is ter gelegenheid van dit jubileum dan ook uitgeschreven in een
nieuwe "Actua", namelijk Actua 64 met als toepasselijke titel "100 jaar tram naar het Van
Beverenplein: wat een geschiedenis!"

De actua is te raadplegen door op de preview hieronder te klikken, of via de ["Publicaties"
pagina.][17]

[[Actua 64]][18]

### [ Kersttram 2024 ][30]

Uitzonderlijk rijden er dit jaar geen nostalgische kersttrams in Gent, Antwerpen of aan de kust.

De reden hiervoor is dat De Lijn en de erfgoedverenigingen sinds de tramjubilea in Gent (2024) en
Antwerpen (2023) werken aan een vernieuwd, robuust kader voor rijdende erfgoedtrams op het netwerk.
De veiligheid van zowel reizigers, vrijwillige medewerkers en andere weggebruikers staat daarin
centraal.
* [Read more about Kersttram 2024][31]

### [ 150 jaar tram Gent: sporen door de tijd ][32]

Naar aanleiding van de viering van 150 jaar tram in Gent, is er door uitgeverij Snoeck (In opdracht
van Meta Vzw & in nauwe samenwerking met ETG Vzw) ook een boek uitgebracht, met als titel: "150 jaar
tram Gent: sporen door de tijd"

Dit rijkelijk geillustreerd boek neemt je mee op een historische reis door 150 jaar tramgeschiedenis
in Gent.
Aan de hand van nooit eerder gepubliceerde foto's, anekdotes en de meest markante mijlpalen ontdek
je het onweerstaanbare verhaal over anderhalve eeuw trams in onze Arteveldestad.

Verkrijgbaar in de betere boekhandel, en via [de webshop van Meta Vzw][33].

[[cover boek 150j tram]][34]
* [Read more about 150 jaar tram Gent: sporen door de tijd][35]

### [ NMVB Netplannen 1934 & 1944 ][36]

Door toedoen van een gulle schenker kregen we enige tijd geleden een archief in ons bezit bestaande
uit zowel NMVB documenten en materiaal, als De Lijn documenten en materiaal.

In samenwerking met onze collega's van Nostalbus was een deel daarvan reeds te zien op hun
opendeurdag in Lochristi begin Juni.
Ondermeer de NMVB netplannen uit 1934 en 1944 werden voor die gelegenheid gedigitaliseerd en
gereproduceerd.

Gezien dat deze plannen samen de evolutie tonen van het NMVB netwerk tussen 1934 en 1944, zijn ze
ook toegevoegd aan de [historische documenten][37] sectie van onze website.

Te bekijken door [hier te klikken voor 1934][38], [hier voor 1944][39], of op de afbeeldingen
hieronder.

[[nmvb netplan 1934]][40]

[[nmvb netplan 1944]][41]
* [Read more about NMVB Netplannen 1934 & 1944][42]

Reeds meerdere jaren in voorbereiding samen met de collega's van Meta Vzw, en meer nieuws volgt heel
spoedig, maar nu kunnen we alvast de datums aankondigen van de viering van 150j tram in Gent: 18&19
mei 2024.

[[-]][44]
* [Read more about Bekendmaking Datums Viering 150j Tram][45]

Ook in 2023 zetten we natuurlijk de traditie met onze sfeervolle Ex-MIVG kersttram verder in Gent!

[_]

Op zaterdag 16 en zondag 17 december , en vrijdag 22&29 en zaterdag 23&30 december kan je in Gent
meesporen met onze sfeervol verlichte Kersttram, dit steeds tussen 17u en 22u.

### Our Company

Greenbrier Europe encompasses Greenbrier’s European operations, including its Leasing division, with
headquarters in Świdnica, Poland; and Arad, Romania. The company is guided by a highly experienced,
Europe-based management team.

[More][336]

We are dedicated to fostering the sustainable, long-term growth of the Group, guiding its evolution
into a technologically advanced and financially robust market leader in Europe’s rail industry.

Through continuous improvements and a focus on customer satisfaction, we strive to exceed
expectations and maintain our reputation as a leader in the rail industry.

## What is the Japan Rail Pass?

The Japan Rail Pass (JR Pass) is a single ticket that gives you **unlimited train travel.**

It is widely regarded as the **best and easiest way** to travel around Japan by train, saving you
money with affordable prices.

The JR Pass is exclusively available to visitors to Japan from overseas and covers journeys across
all of Japan train network. It includes the famous **[Shinkansen bullet trains][48]**, airport

hours if you live in the US, UK, Canada, or Europe.

If you live in an isolated area of a large country, such as parts of Australia and Brazil, it may
take longer. However, it is **unlikely to take longer than 96 hours/4 business days.**

More information in our FAQ
**[How to make seat reservations?][61]**

### What is included in the Japan Rail Pass?

The Japan Rail Pass is valid on:
* Shinkansen high-speed trains
* JR Express and local trains
* JR Local buses
* Airport transfer trains to Tokyo and Osaka international airports

With the JR Pass, you can also enjoy [hotel discounts][62] and [offers at tourist facilities.][63]

More information in our FAQ
**[What is included in the JR Pass?][64]**

### Do the 7 / 14 / 21 days need to be consecutive?

Yes, the selected number of days need to be consecutive. Once activated, the validity period of each
pass cannot be changed or extended.

More information in our FAQ
**[Do the 7 / 14 / 21 days need to be consecutive?][65]**

### How to make seat reservations on the JR Trains?

You can make a reservation before boarding the train. To do this, you must go to **ticketing
machines** or a **JR Ticket Office at the station.**

More information in our FAQ
**[Can I book a seat on the JR Trains?][66]**
[Read more FAQ][67]

## JR Regional Passes

Exploring a specific area of Japan? A Regional Pass is just the ticket!

[Explore all Regional JR Passes][68]

## FAQ

[

### Who is Kontron?

][50]

Kontron is a leading IoT/ Embedded Computer Technology (ECT) company that delivers intelligent
hardware, software, and system solutions across multiple industries. For more than 20 years, Kontron
has helped customers achieve their business goals with technologies for industrial automation,
transportation, communications, healthcare, and energy.

[

### Which industries does Kontron serve?

][51]

Kontron serves a wide range of mission critical industries, including the industrial automation,
transportation, defense and aerospace, energy and utilities, telecommunications and connectivity,
healthcare, and automotive sectors. Across these industries, Kontron provides secure and reliable
embedded and IoT solutions designed for long lifecycles and regulated environments.

[

### How can companies become CRA-compliant with Kontron?

][52]

Kontron supports customers in achieving compliance with the EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) by
delivering secure‑by‑design embedded and edge systems today. This includes risk analysis, long‑term
software maintenance, vulnerability management, secure update mechanisms, and compliance‑ready
development processes aligned with standards such as IEC 62443. Kontron supports the entire product
lifecycle, ensuring long-term availability, and simplifying secure operations

[

### What makes Kontron’s IoT approach different?

][53]

Kontron delivers an integrated industrial IoT software‑first stack that combines secure embedded
hardware with KontronOS, device and fleet management, and cybersecurity solutions. This
software‑centric approach enables long‑term lifecycle management, secure updates, regulatory
readiness, and reliable operation of connected systems - from edge devices to enterprise and cloud
environments.

## FAQ

[

### Who is Kontron?

][50]

Kontron is a leading IoT/ Embedded Computer Technology (ECT) company that delivers intelligent
hardware, software, and system solutions across multiple industries. For more than 20 years, Kontron
has helped customers achieve their business goals with technologies for industrial automation,
transportation, communications, healthcare, and energy.

[

### Which industries does Kontron serve?

][51]

Kontron serves a wide range of mission critical industries, including the industrial automation,
transportation, defense and aerospace, energy and utilities, telecommunications and connectivity,
healthcare, and automotive sectors. Across these industries, Kontron provides secure and reliable
embedded and IoT solutions designed for long lifecycles and regulated environments.

[

### How can companies become CRA-compliant with Kontron?

][52]

Kontron supports customers in achieving compliance with the EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) by
delivering secure‑by‑design embedded and edge systems today. This includes risk analysis, long‑term
software maintenance, vulnerability management, secure update mechanisms, and compliance‑ready
development processes aligned with standards such as IEC 62443. Kontron supports the entire product
lifecycle, ensuring long-term availability, and simplifying secure operations

[

### What makes Kontron’s IoT approach different?

][53]

Kontron delivers an integrated industrial IoT software‑first stack that combines secure embedded
hardware with KontronOS, device and fleet management, and cybersecurity solutions. This
software‑centric approach enables long‑term lifecycle management, secure updates, regulatory
readiness, and reliable operation of connected systems - from edge devices to enterprise and cloud
environments.

# Welcome to Litrols – a Leader in Automation & Instrumentation Market

Litrols is a prominent, leading distributor, supplier and exporter of technologically advanced
Automation, **[Instrumentation][261] **and Electrical products, systems and services used in a broad
range of fields and applications. With our main office in Mumbai, India and in other major cities
such as Giridih, Aurangabad, Chennai, Delhi and Vapi as well as international operation in different
countries, we have the ability to assist our clients worldwide. Our vast range product line covers
Industrial Programmable Controllers, I/O and Fieldbus components, drive technology, automation
software, devices and accessories, and control panels. Our products can be used as separate
components or integrated into a complete and mutually compatible systems are made available for all
sectors.

[Know More][262]

## OUR PRODUCTS

Discover our exceptional multi-disciplinary array of products

### Instrumentation

We offer you innovative, highly engineered pressure, flow, level, temperature, liquid analysis and
gas analyzer process instruments and control systems to increase plant efficiency and enhance
product quality.

### Automation

We boast a strong reputation for providing the best integrated automation solution and products such
as Industrial PCs, I/O and fieldbus components, drive technology and automation software that caters
to all industries.

### Control Panels

We supply a qualitative range of control panels for diverse industrial applications, designed with
utmost care and stringent quality inspection to ensure client satisfaction and are capable of saving
maximum power and energy.

## OUR SERVICES

From planning to after-sales, from design to after-commissioning, we at Litrols offer an array of
flagship services, all custom made to suit your requirements.

## Calibration

We are well-equipped instrument calibration service provider offering process measurement and
**[calibration services][263] **of the highest quality by diagnosing and maintaining your
instruments and keeping them up-to-date at highest accuracy level.

## OpenCorporates was born out of the same frustrations you experience every day

We believe a fairer, more prosperous and sustainable society can only be achieved with greater
corporate transparency.

Since 2010 we’ve been working with government agencies, NGOs and public-benefit groups to improve
the quality and accessibility of the foundational legal-entity data on which you depend.

Today we offer the world's largest open legal-entity database, providing a single unified set of 
company records from over 140 government registries and other official sources around the world.

## Do you really know who you’re dealing with?

We enter into contracts with companies every day. Each of those contracts was with something with
legal personality – almost always a "legal entity". Yet too often we're ignorant of them and who is
behind them, with all the attendant risks that brings.

Whether you're in business, government, journalism, activism, research or a consumer — [our
goal][39] is to help you better understand the companies you deal with.

Search the world’s largest open legal-entity database or plug the data direct into your applications
and processes.

Fresh, standardized, auditable information underpinned by our [Legal-Entity Data Principles][40],

## It shouldn't be hard to get legal-entity data you can trust

And yet it is. Legal-entity information is dispersed across hundreds of business registers that are
hard to navigate and impossible to access at scale. Traditional company-data aggregators are no
longer the answer either, given their opaque processes and provenance.

Verifiable accuracy is more important than ever, and you should expect more.

You need data built on deep expertise, rigorous data models and [well-founded, forward-looking
principles][43]. Data sourced direct from primary sources, curated with clear decision-making and no
hidden bias, and defined by open not proprietary identifiers and standards. Data you know you can
trust.

[ Search now ][44]
[ Plug in our data ][45]

## OpenCorporates was born out of the same frustrations you experience every day

We believe a fairer, more prosperous and sustainable society can only be achieved with greater
corporate transparency.

Since 2010 we’ve been working with government agencies, NGOs and public-benefit groups to improve
the quality and accessibility of the foundational legal-entity data on which you depend.

Today we offer the world's largest open legal-entity database, providing a single unified set of 
company records from over 140 government registries and other official sources around the world.

The Pintsch companies are known internationally as recognized technology partners for the best

railroad signal, train control, and related transportation requirements.

# Welcome to Pintsch North America

The Pintsch companies are known internationally as recognized technology partners for the best
railway wheel sensors, amplifiers, axle counting systems, and industrial products.

Our state-of-the-art products and rail safety solutions ensure maximum reliability and safety for
railroad signal, train control, and related transportation requirements.

Our products have been proven in both the heavy freight, light rail, and industrial sectors for over
25 years. We offer a diverse range of services from applications engineering and design, to complete
turn- key installation services.

protection and control systems, wayside signal applications, advanced industrial automation
solutions, and more.

Kairos Pharma announced a strategic collaboration with Bayer to evaluate Kairos Pharma's lead
antibody ENV-105, a CD105/BMP signaling inhibitor, in combination with Bayer's XOFIGO in metastatic
castration-resistant prostate cancer involving bone. The company said the combination targets an
addressable global market of $570 million to $1.3 billion.

Capital Acquisition Corp. VI that would take the company public on the NYSE, valuing Nth Cycle at an
implied enterprise value of $585 million. The deal is expected to close in the fourth quarter of
2026, subject to regulatory and stockholder approvals.

][16] By Amit Chowdhry ● Today at 4:56 PM
TidalSense announced it has raised £19 million to accelerate the company's team, technology, and its
ability to bring N-Tidal Diagnose, its diagnostic test for chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, to
more patients.  The round was backed by Cross-Border Impact Ventures, BGF, Airstream Capital, and
Foresight Group, a group of investors spanning healthcare-focused and growth-stage capital
providers.
[

### World Foundation Raises $52.5 Million To Expand World ID Infrastructure

][17] By Amit Chowdhry ● Today at 4:54 PM

locked token sale to strategic investors. Pantera Capital led the first close, with participation
from Bain Capital Crypto, Eightco Holdings, Selini Capital, Susquehanna Crypto, and other investors.
All WLD tokens sold as part of the raise are subject to a 12-month lockup.
[

### AegisAI Raises $36 Million Series A To Fight AI Spear Phishing

][18] By Amit Chowdhry ● Today at 4:53 PM
AegisAI, an email security company building its own large language models to defend the inbox,
announced a $36 million Series A led by Battery Ventures, with participation from existing investors
Accel and Foundation Capital. The round brings the company's total funding to $49 million, less than
a year after emerging from stealth. AegisAI will use the funding to scale its fleet of autonomous
defense agents, accelerate general availability of Vanguard, its agent that hunts threats beyond the
inbox, and expand enterprise go-to-market efforts.
[

### Paper Raises $34 Million Series A To Build Design Platform For The Agentic Era

][19] By Amit Chowdhry ● Today at 4:51 PM
Paper, a design platform aimed at the agentic era of software development, announced a $34 million
Series A round led by Accel and ICONIQ. Additional participants include Designer Fund, WorkOS
co-founder Michael Grinich, Lovable founder Anton Osika, and individual engineers and designers from
Anthropic and OpenAI. The company plans to use the funding to accelerate product development, expand
its team, and deepen investment in AI-native workflows for designers.

extending the collaboration into the 2030s. Under the deal, Databricks will deepen its use of Azure
Databricks to run its own core business operations and build its unified lakehouse, while Microsoft
continues integrating Databricks' Data and AI platform across its products, bringing capabilities
like Genie, Databricks' AI co-worker, directly into customer workflows.

semiconductor packaging and test technologies for next-generation AI and accelerated computing
platforms. Under the agreement, NVIDIA will provide a prepayment to support the expansion of Amkor's
U.S. advanced packaging capacity, part of a $1.5 billion multi-year advanced packaging and
development agreement.
[

transition set to take effect April 1, 2027. The appointment, based on a recommendation from the
Nomination and Remuneration Committee, is for a five-year term subject to shareholder approval. Dash
is set to succeed Salil Parekh as Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer following the
completion of Parekh's second term, after more than nine years in the role.

Reach users faster globally
Run your application closer to where your users are.

Everyone ships at full speed
Unlimited environments mean everyone can ship simultaneously.

Every pull request gets its own preview. No surprises after merge.

Rollback to any previous version instantly when something breaks.

[[The Railway Consultancy]][53]

# The Railway Consultancy

The Railway Consultancy provides consultancy services, both nationally and internationally, in the
fields of railway planning, operations, economics, management, strategy and training. Our [areas of
expertise][54] cover both operational and demand planning, and work is carried out for a range of
clients, both in the UK and overseas.

[The Railway Consultancy]

[The Railway Consultancy]

[The Railway Consultancy]

On other pages you can find details of our experience gained across a wide range of [rail planning
projects][55], some of them using our in-house [GCOST™][56] and [Trakattk™][57] models.

[Crystal Palace]

We have worked for many train operators, including Southern. Pictured here are two Southern trains
passing underneath our previous office at Crystal Palace Station.

The Railway Consultancy is involved in activities across the major fields of commercial and
operational planning for railways, including metro, suburban, inter-city passenger, and freight.
Projects we have worked are organised under the following headings:
* [Feasibility Studies][58]
* [Commercial Planning][59]
* [Operational Planning][60]
* [Management & Strategy][61]
* [Audit & Assessment][62]
* [Analysis, Research & Training][63]

Already delivered and in service:
* Liverpool South Parkway Station
* Class 455 redesign
* Revised timetable allowances to improve punctuality on SWR, Southern, LNER and in Norway
* HS2 service specification improved to benefit Stoke-on-Trent

[The Railway Consultancy]

Our [ethos][64] is through Company Policies for the important issues of Safety, Quality,
Environment, Charity Support, Recruitment and Training.

[[The Railway Consultancy]][53]

# The Railway Consultancy

The Railway Consultancy provides consultancy services, both nationally and internationally, in the
fields of railway planning, operations, economics, management, strategy and training. Our [areas of
expertise][54] cover both operational and demand planning, and work is carried out for a range of
clients, both in the UK and overseas.

[The Railway Consultancy]

[The Railway Consultancy]

[The Railway Consultancy]

On other pages you can find details of our experience gained across a wide range of [rail planning
projects][55], some of them using our in-house [GCOST™][56] and [Trakattk™][57] models.

[Crystal Palace]

We have worked for many train operators, including Southern. Pictured here are two Southern trains
passing underneath our previous office at Crystal Palace Station.

The Railway Consultancy is involved in activities across the major fields of commercial and
operational planning for railways, including metro, suburban, inter-city passenger, and freight.
Projects we have worked are organised under the following headings:
* [Feasibility Studies][58]
* [Commercial Planning][59]
* [Operational Planning][60]
* [Management & Strategy][61]
* [Audit & Assessment][62]
* [Analysis, Research & Training][63]

Already delivered and in service:
* Liverpool South Parkway Station
* Class 455 redesign
* Revised timetable allowances to improve punctuality on SWR, Southern, LNER and in Norway
* HS2 service specification improved to benefit Stoke-on-Trent

[The Railway Consultancy]

Our [ethos][64] is through Company Policies for the important issues of Safety, Quality,
Environment, Charity Support, Recruitment and Training.

    ### [Corrective, Preventive and Predictive maintenance for railway applications][27]
    
    [railwaysignalling.eu][28] - January 7, 2017 [1][29]
    Railway maintenance is defined as the process of preserving a working condition of a railway
    equipment, along the track or related to rolling stocks, but there are actually different
    approach to mantain a railway asset or service..
    [News][30]
    
    ### [Introduction to CBTC system description][31]
    
    [railwaysignalling.eu][32] - June 14, 2016 [2][33]
    With CBTC, moving blocks introduce to the concept of contiguous track, because the railway is
    represented as a single contiguous block, rather than a set of adjacent blocks. This means that
    the safe separation behind the preceding train is dynamically calculated based on the maximum
    operating speeds, braking curves and locations of the trains on the alignment. Also, in this way
    the capacity of the railway is extremely increased.
    [News][34]
    
    ### [Conventional vs CABS vs CBTC railway signalling & their impact to capacity][35]
    
    [railwaysignalling.eu][36] - March 8, 2016 [1][37]
    In railway signalling, capacity can be defined as the maximum number of trains that can pass a
    given location during a given time period at a specified level of reliability.
    [News][38]
    
    ### [Formal methods in railway signalling systems][39]
    
    - February 29, 2016 [1][40]
    Strict safety requirements regulate the development of railway signalling and train control
    systems, covered by the CENELEC (European Committee for Electro-technical Standardization) EN
    5012x rail standards
    [News][41]
    
    ### [Happy new year to our 4000+ members!][42]
    
    [railwaysignalling.eu][43] - January 13, 2016 [1][44]
    Thanks to all of our members, 4000 times!

    [railwaysignalling.eu][48] - June 25, 2015 [0][49]
    This paper will drive you across the different phases of the V-cycle for railway application, by
    explaining the key role of requirements during each phase and presenting the Systems Engineering
    activities required to support and control product development.
    [White papers][50]
    
    ### [How Track Circuits detect and protect trains: download your PDF copy!][51]
    
    [railwaysignalling.eu][52] - November 5, 2014 [2][53]
    Track circuits contributes for train detection but also for the vehicle’s speed control, since
    the electrical signals used for train detection can be exchanged between wayside and on-board
    for the transmission of speed commands.
    [White papers][54]
    
    ### [Environmental Sustainability of Rail Transportation][55]
    
    [railwaysignalling.eu][56] - November 25, 2013 [0][57]
    Since the train can be considered the transport mode of the future, national railway companies
    and European Union are currently working for a continuos upgrade of sustainable rail
    transportation, in order to guarantee the best quality of life to European citizens.
    [ERTMS][58]
    
    ### [Railway signalling since the birth to ERTMS][59]
    
    [railwaysignalling.eu][60] - November 5, 2013 [0][61]
    Railway signalling can be defined as all systems used to control railway traffic safely,
    essentially to prevent trains from colliding. Over the years knoledgment and technology able to
    satisfy this issue have been implemented. ERTMS/ETCS is currently the most common signalling
    system adopted in Europe.

glass insulators (with over 650+ million of insulators in service worldwide), Sediver is the proven
world expert in transmission insulator technology.

## Unequalled service experiencee

Sediver offers innovative high-quality toughened glass insulators designed to perform under all
kinds of environmental conditions.

Our outstanding products performance and reliability come from our unique technical expertise gained
through extensive and continuous R&D investments in design, manufacturing and testing.

With more than 95 years of successful experience in insulations and 75 years dedicated to toughened
glass insulators (with over 650+ million of insulators in service worldwide), Sediver is the proven
world expert in transmission insulator technology.

[ Our products][33]

[ Picture]

## Innovative driven company

Always on the lookout for the latest advances and continuous technological improvements, Sediver
heavily invests in Research & Development and has pioneered some of the major innovations of this
industry.

Relying on a world renown team of experts, state-of-the-art testing facilities and 70 years of field
observation and research in innovative material and digital technologies, Sediver is constantly
increasing the reliability of its products to deliver more value to the market..

# Shipbuilding

The shipbuilding industry is a highly complex and technology-intensive sector. The SINCHOLD flexible
track fixing system can optimally meet the diverse and dynamic production demands of modern
shipyards, significantly enhancing the efficiency and safety of material handling, component
assembly, and ship commissioning processes.

][22]
[

### Port and Terminal

As critical hubs of maritime transportation, ports and terminals handle massive cargo
loading/unloading and transfer operations. The SINCHOLD Flexible Rail System can adapt to various
complex terminal layouts and loading/unloading processes, enabling fast and accurate cargo handling.
Additionally, by integrating with automated equipment, it facilitates automated loading and
unloading operations, reducing manual intervention and improving operational efficiency.

][23]
[
****

### Railway

SINCHOLD Flexible Track Fastening System is an innovative rail transit solution that integrates
advanced materials science and engineering technologies. Featuring a unique flexible structural
design, the system ensures essential rigidity while providing controlled elastic deformation
capability. The SINCHOLD design not only enhances track adaptability and durability but also
significantly improves the smoothness and safety of high-speed train operations. By effectively
absorbing vibrations and dynamic loads, it reduces wear on both rails and rolling stock, delivering
superior performance in demanding railway environments. 

][24]
[

### metallurgy

In the electrometallurgy sectors, there is a growing demand for material handling, production line
automation, and operations in extreme environments. Conventional rail systems often struggle to meet
these complex and variable production requirements. In response, the SINCHOLD Flexible Rail
System has emerged as an ideal solution, offering high flexibility, exceptional strength, precision,
and efficiency.

][25]
[

### Aerospace

In the aerospace field, flexible rail systems are primarily used in the manufacturing and assembly
processes of aircraft. These systems utilize specialized flexible rails and vacuum suction cups to
enable stable and precise movement of equipment over the workpiece. The system is highly adaptable
to surfaces with different curvatures, allowing it to process fuselages of varying diameters and
different types of components, such as fuselages and wings. Additionally, the flexible rail system
is easy to operate, convenient to move between workstations, and can be shared across different
aircraft models.

][26]
[

### coking

During the raw material preparation stage in coking plants, the SINCHOLD Flexible Rail System can be
used for coal handling. Due to its high flexibility and strong adaptability, the flexible rail
system enables efficient coal transportation in complex site environments. This reduces the labor
intensity of manual handling and improves operational efficiency.

][27]
[

### Mining

Coal mining often faces complex and variable geological conditions. The SINCHOLD Flexible Rail
System can be adjusted in layout and shape as needed to adapt to different coal seam occurrences
(variations) and mining requirements. This adaptability helps reduce equipment damage and safety
hazards during the mining process.

][28]
[

### Heavy Industry Manufacturing

The SINCHOLD Flexible Rail System is suitable for various heavy industry manufacturing sectors,
including automotive manufacturing, precision machinery, new energy, new materials, logistics, and
warehousing, capable of meeting the material handling needs across different industries.

][29]
[

### Automated Warehousing

The application of the SINCHOLD Flexible Rail System in automated warehousing is both innovative and
efficient, combining the advantages of automation, intelligence, and flexibility to bring
significant improvements to warehouse management. Specific applications include: Intelligent
Shelving Systems, Automated Guided Vehicle (AGV) Systems, Sorting and Packaging Systems.

][30]
[

### Municipal Works

In sports venues, sliding roof systems are a common feature used to regulate the internal
temperature and lighting of the facility. The SINCHOLD Flexible Rail System can provide stable and
smooth track support for sliding roofs, ensuring that the roof moves smoothly along the
predetermined trajectory.

### Shipbuilding

The shipbuilding industry is a highly complex and technology-intensive sector. The SINCHOLD Flexible
Rail Fixing System can meet these complex and ever-changing production demands to the greatest
extent, making material handling, component assembly, and ship commissioning processes more
efficient and safer.

[Port and Terminal]

### Port and Terminal

As critical hubs of maritime transportation, ports and terminals handle massive cargo
loading/unloading and transfer operations. The SINCHOLD Flexible Rail System can adapt to various
complex terminal layouts and loading/unloading processes, enabling fast and accurate cargo handling.
Additionally, by integrating with automated equipment, it facilitates automated loading and
unloading operations, reducing manual intervention and improving operational efficiency.

[Railway]

### Railway

SINCHOLD Flexible Track Fastening System is an innovative rail transit solution that integrates
advanced materials science and engineering technologies. Featuring a unique flexible structural
design, the system ensures essential rigidity while providing controlled elastic deformation
capability. The SINCHOLD design not only enhances track adaptability and durability but also
significantly improves the smoothness and safety of high-speed train operations. By effectively
absorbing vibrations and dynamic loads, it reduces wear on both rails and rolling stock, delivering
superior performance in demanding railway environments.

[metallurgy]

### metallurgy

In the electrometallurgy sectors, there is a growing demand for material handling, production line
automation, and operations in extreme environments. Conventional rail systems often struggle to meet
these complex and variable production requirements. In response, the SINCHOLD Flexible Rail
System has emerged as an ideal solution, offering high flexibility, exceptional strength, precision,
and efficiency.

[Aerospace ]

### Aerospace

In the aerospace field, flexible rail systems are primarily used in the manufacturing and assembly
processes of aircraft. These systems utilize specialized flexible rails and vacuum suction cups to
enable stable and precise movement of equipment over the workpiece. The system is highly adaptable
to surfaces with different curvatures, allowing it to process fuselages of varying diameters and
different types of components, such as fuselages and wings. Additionally, the flexible rail system
is easy to operate, convenient to move between workstations, and can be shared across different
aircraft models.

[Coking ]

### Coking

During the raw material preparation stage in coking plants, the SINCHOLD Flexible Rail System can be
used for coal handling. Due to its high flexibility and strong adaptability, the flexible rail
system enables efficient coal transportation in complex site environments. This reduces the labor
intensity of manual handling and improves operational efficiency.

[Mining ]

### Mining

Coal mining often faces complex and variable geological conditions. The SINCHOLD Flexible Rail
System can be adjusted in layout and shape as needed to adapt to different coal seam occurrences
(variations) and mining requirements. This adaptability helps reduce equipment damage and safety
hazards during the mining process.

[Heavy Industry Manufacturing]

### Heavy Industry Manufacturing

The SINCHOLD Flexible Rail System is suitable for various heavy industry manufacturing sectors,
including automotive manufacturing, precision machinery, new energy, new materials, logistics, and
warehousing, capable of meeting the material handling needs across different industries.

[Automated Warehousing ]

### Automated Warehousing

The application of the SINCHOLD Flexible Rail System in automated warehousing is both innovative and
efficient, combining the advantages of automation, intelligence, and flexibility to bring
significant improvements to warehouse management. Specific applications include: Intelligent
Shelving Systems, Automated Guided Vehicle (AGV) Systems, Sorting and Packaging Systems.

[Municipal Works]

### Municipal Works

In sports venues, sliding roof systems are a common feature used to regulate the internal
temperature and lighting of the facility. The SINCHOLD Flexible Rail System can provide stable and
smooth track support for sliding roofs, ensuring that the roof moves smoothly along the
predetermined trajectory.

## SMART Railway Technology GmbH

Sie sind auf der Suche nach einem kompetenten Ansprechpartner für Leistungselektronik von
Schienenfahrzeugen? Als Anbieter von Standardprodukten sowie von kundenspezifischen Seriengeräten
finden wir für Sie eine auf Ihre Bedürfnisse zugeschnittene Lösung.

Denn SMART Railway steht seit Jahrzehnten für alles aus einer Hand. Vom Angebot bis zum Ende der
Lebensdauer finden Sie bei uns Know-How in jeder Phase Ihres Projekts.



Neuzugang im Portfolio

Seit Januar 2024 neu im Portfolio: mit PV2Rail stellt SMART Railway einen spezialisierten
Photovoltaik-Wechselrichter vor, der darauf ausgelegt ist, direkt in das 16,7 Hz Bahnstromnetz
einzuspeisen. Diese Innovation ermöglicht die direkte Nutzung von erneuerbaren Energien in der
unmittelbaren Nähe von Bahntrassen, ohne den kostspieligen Umweg über das herkömmliche dreiphasige
50 Hz-Netz gehen zu müssen. PV2Rail ist somit eine verbrauchernahe und energieeffiziente Lösung.



[ mehr » ][27]





Produktübersicht

Die  SMART Railway ist Hersteller von innovativen Bordnetzumrichtern für den internationalen
Schienenverkehr. Das Produktspektrum reicht von Einzelgeräten wie Batterieladegeräten oder
Klimaumrichtern bis hin zu kompletten Bordnetzumrichtern für Reisezugwagen und Triebzüge. Die
vielfältig einsetzbare Systemtechnik zeichnet sich durch zukunftsweisende Leistungselektronik, hohe
Zuverlässigkeit und Robustheit aus.

[Dinghan Germany - Ihr Partner für Leistungselektronik von Schienenfahrzeugen]



[ mehr » ][28]





Unternehmen

SMART Railway – dieser Name steht für jahrzehntelange Erfahrung auf dem Gebiet hocheffizienter
Bordnetzumrichter für den Schienenverkehr. Die Geschichte des heute zur Dinghan Group gehörenden
Unternehmens weist eine kontinuierliche Entwicklung zuverlässiger und auf die Anforderungen der
Bahntechnik zugeschnittener Produkte auf. Seit mehr als 30 Jahren entwickelt und fertigt das in
Kassel ansässige Unternehmen leistungselektronische Lösungen.



[ mehr » ][29]





Wir als Arbeitgeber

Unsere Ideen fahren durch die Welt: Mehr als 10.000 Schienenfahrzeuge fahren bereits mit Systemen
der SMART Railway Technology GmbH, dem weltweiten Technologieführer und größten Hersteller für
Bordnetzumrichter. Mit Leidenschaft, Begeisterung und Visionskraft entwickeln wir anspruchsvolle
Leistungselektronik für den globalen Schienenverkehr. Als erfolgreiches Tochterunternehmen eines
großen internationalen Konzerns bieten wir unseren mehr als 160 Mitarbeitern jede Menge
Gestaltungsfreiraum und beste Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem interkulturellen und
partnerschaftlichen Umfeld. Gemeinsam bewegen wir viel und verändern den Markt – in einer Branche,
die nach vorne schaut. 



[ mehr » ][30]

## SMART Railway Technology GmbH

Sie sind auf der Suche nach einem kompetenten Ansprechpartner für Leistungselektronik von
Schienenfahrzeugen? Als Anbieter von Standardprodukten sowie von kundenspezifischen Seriengeräten
finden wir für Sie eine auf Ihre Bedürfnisse zugeschnittene Lösung.

Denn SMART Railway steht seit Jahrzehnten für alles aus einer Hand. Vom Angebot bis zum Ende der
Lebensdauer finden Sie bei uns Know-How in jeder Phase Ihres Projekts.



Neuzugang im Portfolio

Seit Januar 2024 neu im Portfolio: mit PV2Rail stellt SMART Railway einen spezialisierten
Photovoltaik-Wechselrichter vor, der darauf ausgelegt ist, direkt in das 16,7 Hz Bahnstromnetz
einzuspeisen. Diese Innovation ermöglicht die direkte Nutzung von erneuerbaren Energien in der
unmittelbaren Nähe von Bahntrassen, ohne den kostspieligen Umweg über das herkömmliche dreiphasige
50 Hz-Netz gehen zu müssen. PV2Rail ist somit eine verbrauchernahe und energieeffiziente Lösung.

# Virtual Rails. True Skills.

You can do it faster with us.

##### Railworks train simulator – Motion Platforms

## Smart Simulation company is *train simulator* manufacturer supplier

We specialises in the design, manufacturer and instalation of commercial railway simulators to be
used for traininng drivers. Smart simulation can build a cost-effective and flexible custom train
driving simulator solution to meet your needs. We offers full scale replica cab simulators for
stationary or motion-based installation and desk simulators with additional displays.

## One platform, many trains

A unified simulator architecture that supports multiple rolling stock types within a single
platform. This allows consistent training workflows while simplifying development, integration, and
long-term maintenance.

 

#### We have more than
#### 15 years of experience

Over 450 railway simulators across 5 countries. 15 years practice as a manufacturer for high
perfomance train driving simulators

## Choose the building technology blocks you need for your **custom training center**

Our full-cabin and flexible simulators immerse your students in a high-quality version of their real
operating environment, while our light console is affordable, mobile and scalable.

All simulators can be adapted to suit your tasks and budget.

##### FULL-CAB SIMULATOR

## An uncompromising solution for training professionals

A complete copy of the controls, a full-featured console, compact motion system and a view similar
to a real locomotive cab take the learning experience to a new level, allow you to work while
simulating the entire range of work and various normal and abnormal situations that arise on the
rolling railway.

[ MORE][31]

##### OPTIMISED CABIN SIMULATOR

## Full immersion
## for an optimum price

Specially designed replicas of control panels, complemented by a full-sized cabin and highly
detailed copies of real railway routes, provide a full immersion of a specialist in the train
control process.

[ more][32]

##### FLEXIBLE SIMULATOR

## Great solution
## with flexibility

Simulators on an open platform not only allow you to simulate the process of controlling a variety
of locomotives, but also have compatibility with various additional equipment.

[ more][33]

##### PORTABLE SIMULATOR

## Compact size. Powerful training.

This ultra-compact portable simulator fits easily into any training space. Featuring responsive
touchscreens for realistic locomotive control, it’s perfect for group sessions — with multiple desks
managed seamlessly from a single instructor station. Scalable, space-saving, and ready to go.

[ more][34]

## A few reasons why choose us

We asked our clients why they choose us when creating an own training center for their employees.

#### Reliability

Thanks to the solid grounding of our employees, we guarantee results and deadlines.

#### flexibility

We will select the ideal solution for your tasks and resources, in order to start the learning
process as quickly as possible.

#### multiculturalism

We have a distributed team. We speak different languages, so rest assured that we will understand
you and your task.

#### price

We have internal resources to guarantee you an adequate price for our solutions, so you can safely
contact us.

We will be happy to answer any of your questions.

# Virtual Rails. True Skills.

You can do it faster with us.

##### Railworks train simulator – Motion Platforms

## Smart Simulation company is *train simulator* manufacturer supplier

We specialises in the design, manufacturer and instalation of commercial railway simulators to be
used for traininng drivers. Smart simulation can build a cost-effective and flexible custom train
driving simulator solution to meet your needs. We offers full scale replica cab simulators for
stationary or motion-based installation and desk simulators with additional displays.

## One platform, many trains

A unified simulator architecture that supports multiple rolling stock types within a single
platform. This allows consistent training workflows while simplifying development, integration, and
long-term maintenance.

 

#### We have more than
#### 15 years of experience

Over 450 railway simulators across 5 countries. 15 years practice as a manufacturer for high
perfomance train driving simulators
